subject: Request: launch sponsorship + combined credit/discount exception for StratusLane POC
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: emily.zhao@stratuslane.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StratusLane POC — request for combined credits + launch sponsorship

Emily — great to meet on Friday. Quick follow-up with a concrete request so we can accelerate the POC and landing team kickoff.

Summary request:
- 2-week extension of the current trial window (current expiry 07/15) to 07/29 so StratusLane can complete the end-to-end integration tests.
- $30,000 in platform credits applied to the first invoice to cover peak inference during integration (one-time, non-recurring).
- 20% promotional discount on list rates for first 12 months if StratusLane signs a 12-month committed plan by 08/15.
- Redwood to provide launch sponsorship: co-branded case study + joint announcement support if they meet go-live criteria within 90 days.

Why this is reasonable:
- StratusLane has a clear launch timeline and is willing to commit to a 12-month order if we help bridge the integration delta this month.
- Joint marketing will amplify adoption for both teams and reduce ramp time.

I've attached a short mutual action plan (attachment) and a draft SOW from their PM. If you agree, I need executive signoff on the combined credit + discount exception (+ the sponsorship ask) so we can get legal and finance moving.

Next step: If you can confirm approval path and redlines we need to accept, I will push to finalize before EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: StratusLane_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (1.2 MB)

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@stratuslane.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Legal <legal@stratuslane.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusLane POC — request for combined credits + launch sponsorship

Laura — thanks, this is very clear and appreciated. A couple clarifications from our side:
- The extension to 07/29 is critical — our infra lead is out until 07/20 and we lose a week otherwise.
- The $30k credit will cover our projected peak token usage for the extended tests; we would prefer the credit applied as an upfront invoice credit rather than a post-hoc refund.
- The 20% promotional discount needs to be applied to the committed SKU (we intend to commit to the “dedicated inference” plan at the 2x node tier) and be visible on the first-year invoice.
- For co-marketing: we need an express lane approval for a 1-page joint case study + short quote approval window (48 hours).

I attached a one-page SOW so you can see acceptance criteria and go-live gates. If you can get exec signoff this week, we can execute on both the commitment and the announcement timeline.

Appreciate the help,
Emily
Director of Product, StratusLane

Attachment: SOW_Draft_StratusLane.docx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: StratusLane POC — request for combined credits + launch sponsorship (need exec approval)

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding the thread and SOW. Short ask below — can you greenlight an exception for this deal?

Ask (decision required):
- Approve application of $30,000 one-time platform credit applied as an upfront invoice credit to the first invoice.
- Approve 20% promotional discount on first 12 months for the committed Dedicated plan, contingent on a signed 12-month commitment by 08/15.
- Approve Redwood marketing to support the launch (case study + announcement) with a 48-hour quote approval SLA.

Business rationale:
- Probable ARR: ~$180k first-year committed if they convert at the 2x node tier.
- Strategic: StratusLane is well-connected in the logistics vertical and has existing pilot customers we can showcase; strong PR / co-marketing upside.
- Risk control: credits are one-time, discount limited to 12 months, and commit date is explicit.

If you approve, I will instruct finance/legal to prepare the sponsor credit memo and the discount addendum to the MSA. I can also attach the mutual action plan and list exactly how credits will be consumed.

Please reply with Approved / Approved with conditions / Decline + rationale. Quick timeline request: we need signoff by EOD Wednesday to meet StratusLane’s integration window.

Thanks,
Laura
Enterprise AE

Attachment: Pricing_Sheet_Q3_2027.xlsx
